steps.text: Hello, little chefs! I'm Chef Maya. Let's simmer a comforting pot of garden vegetable soup!
Wash your hands thoroughly. Stoves and boiling soup are very hot, so an adult must handle the heat.
We have bright chopped carrots, green peas, clear vegetable broth, and fragrant fresh herbs.
Carefully add the chopped vegetables into our deep soup pot.
Pour in our warm golden broth so the sweet vegetables are gently submerged.
Let the soup simmer gently and stir slowly as the kitchen fills with cozy warmth.
Ladle the steamy vegetable soup into a warm serving bowl. So wholesome and comforting!
